failure_modes.description: Process state or flux norm grows without bound as n -> infinity.
Incorrectly assuming every stable system reaches a unique fixed point.
Recurrence basins break into disconnected or unstable sub-regions.
Transport flux sequence does not have a finite limit.
Number of admissible branches grows faster than pruning capacity over time.
Orientation minimization traps the system in a non-functional state.
System state eventually contacts or crosses window boundaries due to drift.
Non-local connections lead to unbounded state expansion across loci.
